title: Homogeneity of the coordinate Laplacian
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $\pi$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, and let $f:\Omega^n\to\mathbb R$. For every coordinate $i$ and scalar $c\in\mathbb R$, the product coordinate Laplacian of $cf$ is $c$ times the product coordinate Laplacian of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
